versions.changelog:
Initial release of Barbie Style Generator:

- Converts any description into AI-generated Barbie-style portraits with hyper-feminine, fashion doll aesthetics.
- Supports pastel-saturated, pink editorial, and Barbie movie-inspired looks.
- Integrates with the Neta AI image generation API (requires free API token).
- Command-line usage with options for image size and style inheritance via reference image.
- Ideal for social media, branded visuals, and creative content.
